label: Orders in pending cases
caption: COMMITTEES OF U.S. HOUSE OF REP. V. TRUMP, DONALD J., ET AL.
text: The applications for orders to issue the judgments forthwith, presented to The Chief Justice and by him referred to the Court, are denied. Justice Sotomayor would grant the applications.
